reviews.text: Everything is perfect. There are good doctors, especially Dr. Gomara, and they are all very kind. I've been taking my dogs and cats to Dr. Gomara for 10 years.

Poor communication and lack of accountability.
I called ahead to confirm they accepted walk-ins. Not once was I asked if my dog was existing patient. I arrived and was told they couldn’t see my dog because they’re not taking new patients. When I pointed out that this could’ve been avoided if they had simply asked over the phone, the receptionist claimed she did, which is absolutely not true. Instead of taking accountability, she doubled down. A complete waste of time and very frustrating, especially when your pet needs care. I won’t be coming back.

I went with an appointment for a travel certificate and had to wait over 2 hours to be seen, the lady at the front desk is extremely rude, makes faces and gives you an attitude as if she is doing you a favor. Got told that the doctor was going to do me a favor and correct travel date to see if I got the certificate, a favor when I paid for this service. I took my cat to this clinic due to weight loss, behavioral changes, and fever. The veterinarian diagnosed him with "an infection", prescribed an antibiotic and fever medication, and sent us home. When I mentioned that his belly appeared bloated, the doctor dismissed it as unimportant and told us to wait for the lab results.

Two days later, they called and assured us that he should recover with the antibiotic. However, he was diagnosed today with Feline Infectious Peritonitis (FIP), a lethal viral disease that does not require antibiotics. With timely antiviral treatment, cats can survive FIP. Unfortunately, this clinic wasted precious time, and looking back at his symptoms and lab results, they should have recognized the signs sooner. Had they been more attentive, my cat could already be receiving treatment with a real chance of recovery.

I do not recommend this place!
